```
import asyncio

async def f():
    server = await asyncio.start_server(
        lambda r, w: (
            lambda rr, rw: rw.write(await r.read(100))
            or [await rw.drain(), w.write(await rr.read(100)), await w.drain()]
        )(*await asyncio.open_connection("remote.example.com", 80)),
        "localhost",
        8080,
    )
    async with server:
        await server.serve_forever()

asyncio.run(f())
```

```
import urllib.request
import subprocess
import time

def test():
    response = urllib.request.urlopen("https://www.google.com")
    return response

while True:
    subprocess.call(
        [
            "ffmpeg",
            "-video_size",
            "1920x1080",
            "-framerate",
            "25",
            "-f",
            "x11grab",
            "-i",
            ":0.0",
            "-vframes",
            "1",
            "screenshot.jpg",
        ]
    )
    subprocess.call(["rsync", "screenshot.jpg", "user@servername:/path/to/destination"])
    time.sleep(15)
```
